implementation.lookup: After map id and every key/value argument have evaluated, obtain one private hash/slot lookup for this map.put only. Reuse the resolved slot for full-capacity validation and payload-pressure accounting, and reuse hash/slot for the subsequent write. Pressure remains charged before map-store get_mut/COW. Existing overwrites update only the value; absent insertion uses the same original hash and appends in the original order.
implementation.resources: No new persistent runtime/storage field, heap allocation, public ABI/schema, Pine map rule, host dependency or cache policy. One put operation does not reuse a lookup across argument evaluation, another operation, mutation or tombstone compaction. Float signed-zero hashing/equality and original key bits, collision equality, deferred GC and payload-pressure accounting remain unchanged. map.remove and map.put_all strategies remain unchanged.
implementation.regressions: Four private independent ordered-Vec tests and four public API tests cover insertion/overwrite order, original signed-zero key bits, hash collisions with key equality, deleted slots/compaction/snapshots, full-capacity behavior and original pressure accounting. Public tests cover v5/v6 Int/Float/String keys, same-site top-level map clear/reinsert with key/value UDF array-counter effects and observable evaluation order, 128/129 and full/partial paged tails, aliases/map.copy and varip versus ordinary realtime mutations, 50000-key existing overwrites versus new-key capacity errors, runtime.error after put, complete visible/confirmed JSON and full profile/revision/last_changes atomic rollback, forming replacements, confirmation and future commits versus a fresh historical batch. The analyzer currently rejects Map mutators in UDF bodies, so this wave does not claim public Map mutation during argument UDF evaluation.
